name: @corbits-builder/coder
description: Builds the project's code the first time, whatever kind of thing it is, and changes the code the project has, built here or imported.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The project's code needs building for the first time, or the person asks for a change to the code the project has.
builder.unless: The person is still unsure what they want and would rather compare options or see a mockup first.
examples: add a flag that prints the version

facts.app_exists: the project has code, built or imported
facts.!app_exists: the project has no code yet

stack.language.about: The programming language the project's code is written in, such as TypeScript.

stack.starter.about: The starter the project's code started from, when it started from one: web-app for a web app with a browser client and a server, bare for a TypeScript project on Bun that is not a web app. Builder saves it, with the starter's checks as stack.checks and how it starts as stack.run, when a first build names a starter, and writes the starter's files as the project's first code before the coder starts; code that started from an empty project has none.

stack.checks.about: The commands, in order, that prove the project's saved code installs, builds and passes its tests, one per line.

stack.run.about: How the project's program starts so a person can open it in a browser, as { "command": the command that starts it, "port": the environment variable naming the port it answers on, "waitFor": a line it prints once it is ready, if any, "extraPorts": any other variables it needs a free port in }. A project without one serves nothing to open.

web-app.about: A web app people use in a browser: a React client, a Bun server and a shared package.
web-app.setupFailed: If it says the lockfile is frozen, bring bun.lock up to date with install_packages, naming the packages the output says changed at the versions package.json gives them.

bare.about: A TypeScript project on Bun that is not a web app, such as a command-line tool, a library, a script or a service: one package with tests and no framework.
bare.setupFailed: If it says the lockfile is frozen, bring bun.lock up to date with install_packages, naming the packages the output says changed at the versions package.json gives them.
